pictures.name: BI1-Bamboo-Grove
pictures.prompt: A quiet bamboo grove near an ancient Indian city at early evening. Tall green bamboo stems, soft gold light filtering through, a few monks in saffron robes sitting in stillness on the ground. In the middle, the Buddha (a serene man in his thirties, shaved head, calm half-closed eyes, saffron-ochre robe draped over his left shoulder, barefoot, a faint soft glow around him, shown in the traditional respectful way) seated cross-legged on a simple mat, peaceful. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
